data: Programming for Psychologists is an undergraduate course designed to equip psychology students with computational problem-solving skills. Through hands-on exercises in Python and Octave, students will learn to think like programmers, develop scripts to analyse behavioural data, run simulations, and automate research workflows. Emphasis on real-world applications includes data visualisation, statistical modelling, and research practices. The course also introduces LaTeX for creating professional reports and slides for effective presentations. By integrating coding fundamentals with psychological research methods, students will gain practical expertise in computational tools essential for advanced research, enhancing their ability to design experiments, manage datasets, and communicate findings efficiently.
